sections.Profile:
The "Godzilla" pinball machine, manufactured by Sega in 1998, is based on the Godzilla movie released that same year. Designed by Joe Balcer and Joe Kaminkow, with artwork by Morgan Weistling, this machine features several notable elements, including a large Godzilla toy on the playfield, a ball diverter that drops the ball out of Godzilla's mouth, four electromagnets under the playfield, and a shaker motor that adds to the immersive experience. The game was one of the last produced by Sega Pinball before the company transitioned to Stern Pinball.
